subject.title: fix(line): dripping inbound media downloads hang past setup timeout

question: Should LINE inbound media remain exclusively on the official SDK client, requiring an SDK/upstream cancellation seam, or may the plugin permanently own a parallel custom HTTP downloader?
rationale: The SDK currently lacks a public abort/timeout parameter, while current main deliberately uses it; choosing a custom endpoint, readiness policy, and cancellation implementation is an owner-boundary and upgrade-policy decision that tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Preserve SDK ownership
options.body: Rebase on current main and add or upstream an abortable SDK seam while retaining the canonical SDK download behavior.

options.title: Approve custom transport
options.body: Explicitly accept plugin-owned fetch, readiness polling, endpoint, authorization, and timeout semantics with SDK-parity and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve SDK ownership
recommendation.body: Rebase on current main and add or upstream an abortable SDK seam while retaining the canonical SDK download behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for the repository-level SDK-versus-plugin transport ownership choice; file-specific history remains incomplete.
